name: Grinnelli Designs F-22A Raptor
summary: Community F-22A Raptor mod with thrust-vectoring EFM and interactive cockpit, relying on F-15C avionics.
description:
Flyable F-22A with EFM, 6-DoF clickable cockpit, PBR textures and a paint kit. Needs DCS F-15C or Flaming Cliffs 3, and `load_immediately = true` added to `Mods/aircraft/F-15C/entry.lua` (this breaks the integrity check).

Needs the F-15C (or Flaming Cliffs 3) and a manual edit to the F-15C's `entry.lua`, which breaks the multiplayer integrity check. Follow the author's instructions on the release page.

Requires: Requires editing the official F-15C entry.lua (load_immediately = true); fails DCS integrity check.

releases.changelog: LERX vapor, IRST pod, removable pylons, ground-attack role, Mako ARM, FM and gear tuning, bug fixes.
